A bill for an act relating to finance; appropriating money to continue operations of a state agency if a bill to fund the operations of that agency has not been enacted by July 1, 2025.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Appropriations.+]

[+(a) If a bill to fund the operations of a state agency for the biennium beginning July 1, 2025, has not been enacted by that date, amounts sufficient to continue operation of that agency and the programs administered by that agency through July 31, 2025, are appropriated to the agency from the appropriate funds and accounts in the state treasury at the lower of the following levels: +]

[+(1) the base level for that period for that agency, as determined and adjusted according to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.11, subdivision 3, and previous appropriation acts; or +]

[+(2) total fiscal year 2025 appropriations to that agency, divided by 12. +]

[+(b) For purposes of this section, the amount of an appropriation for the period provided in paragraph (a), clause (1), equals the base for that appropriation in fiscal year 2026 as estimated in the forecast of revenues and expenditures, under Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.103, released on March 6, 2025, divided by 12. The base level for an appropriation that was designated as onetime or was onetime in nature is zero. +]

[+(c) For the purposes of this section, "state agency" means an entity in the executive, judicial, or legislative branch of state government. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Legislative Advisory Commission.+]

[+The appropriations under subdivision 1 must not be reduced, except as required to balance expenditures with revenue and after consultation with the Legislative Advisory Commission as required by Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.152, subdivision 4. +]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to finance; appropriating money to continue operations of a state agency if a bill to fund the operations of that agency has not been enacted by July 1, 2025.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS.

Subdivision 1.

Appropriations.

(a) If a bill to fund the operations of a state agency for the biennium beginning July 1, 2025, has not been enacted by that date, amounts sufficient to continue operation of that agency and the programs administered by that agency through July 31, 2025, are appropriated to the agency from the appropriate funds and accounts in the state treasury at the lower of the following levels:

(1) the base level for that period for that agency, as determined and adjusted according to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.11, subdivision 3, and previous appropriation acts; or

(2) total fiscal year 2025 appropriations to that agency, divided by 12.

(b) For purposes of this section, the amount of an appropriation for the period provided in paragraph (a), clause (1), equals the base for that appropriation in fiscal year 2026 as estimated in the forecast of revenues and expenditures, under Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.103, released on March 6, 2025, divided by 12. The base level for an appropriation that was designated as onetime or was onetime in nature is zero.

(c) For the purposes of this section, "state agency" means an entity in the executive, judicial, or legislative branch of state government.

Subd. 2.

Legislative Advisory Commission.

The appropriations under subdivision 1 must not be reduced, except as required to balance expenditures with revenue and after consultation with the Legislative Advisory Commission as required by Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.152, subdivision 4.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: (a) If a bill to fund the operations of a state agency for the biennium beginning July 1, 2025, has not been enacted by that date, amounts sufficient to continue operation of that agency and the programs administered by that agency through July 31, 2025, are appropriated to the agency from the appropriate funds and accounts in the state treasury at the lower of the following levels:
(1) the base level for that period for that agency, as determined and adjusted according to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.11, subdivision 3, and previous appropriation acts; or
(2) total fiscal year 2025 appropriations to that agency, divided by 12.

(b) For purposes of this section, the amount of an appropriation for the period provided in paragraph (a), clause (1), equals the base for that appropriation in fiscal year 2026 as estimated in the forecast of revenues and expenditures, under Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.103, released on March 6, 2025, divided by 12. The base level for an appropriation that was designated as onetime or was onetime in nature is zero.
(c) For the purposes of this section, "state agency" means an entity in the executive, judicial, or legislative branch of state government.

The appropriations under subdivision 1 must not be reduced, except as required to balance expenditures with revenue and after consultation with the Legislative Advisory Commission as required by Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.152, subdivision 4.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
